PANEL VERDICT (3 adversarial lenses, opus, 2026-06-06): all GO-WITH-CONDITIONS. Material corrections to the artifact:

ARCHITECTURE: Artifact is STALE — cca8 DD1+DD3 (rebase-merge + linear source-sync; clean-merge exemption retired) ALREADY landed on main (merge-to-main-pr.sh now 'gh pr merge --auto --rebase'). The §3 skip-rebase-vs-force-push 'dilemma' is substantially solved = O3 ~90% done. RECOMMEND O3 (finish linear-history), NOT O4. O4/merge-queue REJECTED: llm-review is event_name==pull_request-guarded, never reports on merge_group → MQ cannot satisfy the non-negotiable. O2-as-primary REJECTED (symptoms of non-linear history; O3 removes the rebases). LOAD-BEARING: cca8 already REGRESSED via bug e1bf — DD1's new _publish_rebased_branch force-pushes staged-* WITHOUT the _branch_is_staged_promotion guard → GH013 (hit live 3x). O3/DD2 (required_linear_history flip) GATED on fixing e1bf. NOTE: this session's friction was amplified by pinning CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT to the 3ebb merge-to-main (pre-cca8); re-confirm friction against CURRENT main before scoping.

SECURITY: c9e9's HMAC-ledger SHOWSTOPPER is MOOTED (code moved to ADR-0022 identity exemption; merged_by server-set, agent current_user_can_bypass:never → unforgeable). BUT O2's NEW content-hash carry-forward is NOT forge-proof (agent-computable hash / bare patch-id is context-blind → laundering). Real F4 fix needs NO carry-forward: exempt empty-net-diff SHAs (PR1 merge commits) computed IN-GATE (mirror rc_diff_is_tickets_only). O5 CRITICAL: 'strip unknown top-level keys' is a FAIL-CLOSED REGRESSION (empty findings:[] is a valid PASS → could launder). CORRECT O5 = ALLOWLIST fallback_hops in optional_top (it's legit infra output, dispatch.py:817/852). NEW GAP: empty findings:[] passes validation = live fail-open → need a positive review-completed attestation (O5-C2).

RED-TEAM/OPERABILITY: O1 auto-GC of the REMOTE staged ref is far more dangerous than the existing cache-only GC; the 0-ahead 'spent' test can't distinguish spent from not-yet-populated → could delete a concurrent session's staged ref. Shared /tmp GC globs all worktrees, no flock/ownership. CONDITIONS: human-confirm (or forge-side spentness proof) before remote-ref deletion; flock+ownership scoping; preserve INC-008 + merged-PR-guard; make F6 recovery message BLOCKING (detect spent-source, instruct fresh-branch); ship advisory/dry-run first.

CONVERGENCE: O3 is the structural primary (gated on e1bf). O5 = allowlist (not strip) + fix empty-findings fail-open. O2 only as in-gate empty-diff exemption (forge-proof), not carry-forward. O4 rejected. O1 advisory-first + human-gated. Re-confirm friction vs current main.
